P.flaw: The mark's spanner breaks the wheel rim awkwardly and the spokes look like loose dashes, so the mark feels less resolved than the rest of the card.

Q.flaw: The spanner in the mark is small and half hidden behind the wheel, so it reads mostly as a wheel.

print-1.why_top: Q meets every requirement and has a cleaner, more finished spoked-wheel mark, a tidier back footer that pairs the name with the hours, and consistent safe margins, so it looks a little more polished and ready for print than P.
